title: Skincare Routine for Sensitive Skin: A Gentle Day and Night Guide
ex: A short, gentle morning and night skincare routine for sensitive skin, which ingredients tend to suit it, and how to add new products safely.
rt: Skincare Routine for Sensitive Skin: Gentle Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: A gentle skincare routine for sensitive skin: simple morning and night steps, soothing ingredients like panthenol, and how to patch test new products.
quick: Keep a sensitive skin routine short: a mild fragrance-free cleanser, a soothing moisturiser and sunscreen in the morning, and cleanser plus moisturiser at night. Add only one new product at a time, patch test it for 3–5 days, and start actives slowly once skin is calm.
facts: Sensitive skin can be oily, dry or combination.
Add one new product at a time, two weeks apart.
Panthenol is a form of vitamin B5 that acts as a humectant.
Mineral sunscreens often suit reactive skin.
